decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while quickly applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By taxing the opponent's spells with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex, while also utilizing cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine to disrupt their mana base, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan. Meanwhile, powerful hatebears like Archon of Emeria and Anointed Peacekeeper help to maintain control of the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Solitude for removal and Emeria's Call for late-game reach.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively utilize Bazaar of Baghdad to fill up the graveyard with creatures like Vengevine, Squee, Goblin Nabob, and Blazing Rootwalla. This enables powerful plays with cards like Hollow One and Force of Will to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Mindbreak Trap to control the game while applying pressure. The graveyard is a valuable resource that is constantly utilized and recycled with cards like Noxious Revival and Master of Death.

This deck focuses on using the "Oath of Druids" card as a central strategy to quickly bring powerful creatures into play. By controlling the game with counterspells like "Force of Will" and disruption spells like "Flusterstorm", the player can set up the perfect moment to play Oath of Druids and overwhelm their opponent with big creatures like "Atraxa, Grand Unifier". The deck also includes cards like "Show and Tell" and "Tinker" to find and play key artifacts, while using cards like "Narset, Parter of Veils" and "Bolas's Citadel" for added advantage and control.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the pieces needed to cast Doomsday, a powerful sorcery that allows the player to rearrange the top five cards of their library in any order. By setting up a sequence that includes Thassa's Oracle and enough cards in the library to win the game immediately, the player can win in a single turn. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Duress to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key is to efficiently search for and set up the winning sequence while protecting it from disruption.

This deck revolves around the key interaction between Worldgorger Dragon and Animate Dead. By casting Animate Dead on Worldgorger Dragon from the graveyard, it creates a loop that repeatedly enters and leaves the battlefield, resulting in infinite mana and card draw. This combo is enabled by cards like Entomb, Dance of the Dead, and Reanimate to put the Dragon into the graveyard and bring it back. The deck also includes various powerful spells like Force of Will, Demonic Tutor, and Ancestral Recall to support the combo and disrupt opponents.

This deck focuses on using powerful artifacts and disruptive spells to control the game and quickly take down opponents. It combines fast mana acceleration with disruptive counter spells and removal to protect its threats and quickly close out games. By leveraging the power of key artifacts like Time Vault, Sphinx of the Steel Wind, and Bolas's Citadel, along with disruptive creatures like Hullbreacher and White Plume Adventurer, this deck aims to establish an early advantage and maintain control of the game until victory is achieved.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Control deck focuses on utilizing the key card, Oath of Druids, to gain a strategic advantage. The deck aims to cheat powerful creatures or permanents into play by using cards like Show and Tell, Tinker, and Flash. It also includes a variety of powerful spells for control and card advantage, such as Force of Will and Ancestral Recall. The deck also incorporates a small Planeswalker package with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Oko, Thief of Crowns. Overall, the deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's plans while efficiently leveraging the Oath of Druids mechanic.

The main concept of this Vintage 1 vs 1 Combo - Dredge deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder. This allows you to bring back powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Ichorid, while also utilizing recursive creatures like Silversmote Ghoul. By aggressively milling your own deck and taking advantage of graveyard synergies, you can overwhelm your opponent with a fast and powerful board presence, all while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Will and Chalice of the Void.

This deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Bolas's Citadel. It also uses control elements like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo, along with disruptive cards like Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also has powerful win conditions like Time Vault and Tinker. The deck aims to manipulate the game to its advantage, while utilizing key cards like Show and Tell and Demonic Tutor to set up game-winning plays.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the powerful combo potential of Underworld Breach along with various spells and abilities to create a winning strategy. By combining card draw, mana acceleration, and disruptive spells, the deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for its combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan. With the addition of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck gains additional recursion and flexibility to ensure consistency in executing its game plan and achieving victory in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This Azorius Aggro deck focuses on speed and disruption, utilizing powerful mana acceleration cards like Black Lotus and Moxen to quickly drop threats like Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. Control elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares help protect your creatures while countering opponent's threats. The addition of Hullbreacher and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional disruption, while Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer offer card advantage and additional threats. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed, disruption, and powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on creating a powerful synergy between artifacts and abilities that generate large amounts of mana, allowing the player to cast spells quickly and efficiently. By using cards like Mishra's Workshop, Ancient Tomb, and Grim Monolith to ramp up mana production, along with cards like Tinker and Time Vault to create game-winning plays, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its explosive combos. Coveted Jewel serves as a key piece in generating additional card advantage and mana acceleration, solidifying the deck's ability to maintain momentum and outpace the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a combo with Time Vault and Voltaic Key to take multiple extra turns, while also disrupting opponents with countermagic and versatile creatures like Hullbreacher and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. The deck also includes powerful card draw and card selection options like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm to help maintain tempo and consistency. With a mix of fast mana sources and efficient threats, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game, ultimately overwhelming opponents with its versatile game plan.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 deck focuses on assembling the "Coveted Jewel" combo, utilizing cards like Tinker, Grim Monolith, and Paradoxical Outcome to quickly generate mana and draw cards. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Time Vault, Mana Crypt, and Mishra's Workshop to further enhance its combo potential. The inclusion of cards like Force of Will and Karn, the Great Creator provides additional control and disruption options. Overall, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state.

Utilizing a combination of powerful planeswalkers, efficient removal spells, and disruptive counterspells, this Vintage 1 vs 1 deck focuses on controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent. By constantly generating card advantage, manipulating the top of the deck, and disrupting the opponent's mana base, the deck aims to establish dominance and grind out victories through incremental advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Collector Ouphe and Energy Flux enables the deck to effectively combat artifact-based strategies, while the versatile sideboard provides additional answers to specific threats in the format.

The deck revolves around generating fast mana with cards like Ancient Tomb and Grim Monolith, and using them to set up a combo involving Coveted Jewel. The goal is to ramp into playing Coveted Jewel, generating a large amount of mana and card advantage through Urza's Saga and Paradoxical Outcome, and eventually winning the game by either using Karn, the Great Creator to find key artifacts like Time Vault or assembling the combo pieces with cards like Tinker and Demonic Tutor. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential and resource advantage.
